question: At what times can I phone IT for support on a weekday?
reference_answer: The IT help desk takes calls Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 20:00 IST on extension 4100.

question: I can't remember my login password. How can I get back in without calling anyone?
reference_answer: Use the self-service page at https://id.smartdesk.example/reset: enter your work email, approve the prompt in SmartDesk Authenticator and choose a new password.

question: How often does my account password stop working and need replacing?
reference_answer: Passwords expire every 180 days, with reminder emails 14 days and 3 days beforehand.

question: I'm new and need to register my phone for the second sign-in check. Where do I start?
reference_answer: Install SmartDesk Authenticator, sign in at https://id.smartdesk.example/mfa, add a device by scanning the QR code, confirm with the 6-digit code and keep the 10 backup codes safe.

question: I upgraded my handset and the authenticator app isn't on it anymore. What should I do?
reference_answer: While the old phone still works, use Move to a new device at https://id.smartdesk.example/mfa. If it is gone, sign in with a backup code, or call the help desk on extension 4100.

question: Which server name do I enter in the VPN app so it reaches the company network?
reference_answer: Use vpn.smartdesk.example with the SmartDesk-Corp profile in SmartDesk Connect, then sign in and approve the MFA prompt.

question: The VPN says the server can't be reached while I'm on hotel internet. Any ideas?
reference_answer: That is Windows error 809. Check that other sites load, and note that some hotel and public networks block VPN traffic, so try a mobile hotspot.

question: If I'm on the VPN, does my video streaming also go through the company tunnel?
reference_answer: No. The VPN uses split tunnelling, so only traffic for company systems goes through it and streaming uses your own connection.

question: What steps do I follow to get a program installed that isn't offered in the Software Centre?
reference_answer: Raise a Software request at https://helpdesk.smartdesk.example. Your manager approves it, IT Security reviews it within 5 working days and IT installs it, usually within 2 working days of approval.

question: Am I allowed to run a torrent client on my company laptop?
reference_answer: No. Peer-to-peer file-sharing software is not allowed on company laptops.

question: Is it fine to paste our source code into a public AI chatbot to help me debug it?
reference_answer: No. Source code, customer data and internal documents must not go into any online service that is not approved. If it already happened, report it to security@smartdesk.example straight away.

question: A client is visiting tomorrow and needs internet access. How do I arrange that?
reference_answer: They join SmartDesk-Guest and sign in with their name and your work email as sponsor; you approve by email. Access lasts 24 hours and can be extended up to 7 days via a help desk request.

question: Which wireless network should my own phone connect to in the office?
reference_answer: SmartDesk-Guest, after registering the phone with your work email at https://helpdesk.smartdesk.example/wifi. SmartDesk-Secure is only for company laptops.

question: How can I read my company mail on my iPhone?
reference_answer: Install the Outlook app, add your work email address, sign in, approve the MFA prompt and accept the device security policy. Outlook is the only supported mail app.

question: Is there a cap on how large an email attachment can be?
reference_answer: Yes, attachments are limited to 25 MB per message. Larger files should be shared as OneDrive links.

question: I got an odd message asking me to confirm my bank details. What should I do with it?
reference_answer: Don't click anything. Use Report then Phishing in Outlook, or forward it as an attachment to phishing@smartdesk.example. If you already clicked, call Security on extension 4999.

question: What hardware will be waiting for me when I start?
reference_answer: A company laptop (14-inch standard or 16-inch for engineering and data roles) with its adapter and sleeve, a USB-C dock, a wireless keyboard and mouse, and a managed account.

question: I need a second dock for working at home. How do I order one?
reference_answer: Raise a New request, then Equipment, at https://helpdesk.smartdesk.example. Your manager approves and delivery takes up to 5 working days.

question: I left my work laptop in a taxi. Will I be charged for a new one?
reference_answer: Call Security on extension 4999 immediately and raise a request within 24 hours. If the loss was due to negligence you may be asked to pay up to 50% of the depreciated value.

question: I'm resigning next month. How do I hand back my company hardware?
reference_answer: Raise an equipment return request, then return everything to the IT counter or IT store by 17:00 on your last day. Remote staff get a prepaid courier label.

question: What happens on my first morning at the company?
reference_answer: Report to reception at 09:30 (remote joiners attend the video orientation at 10:00 IST), sign your documents with the People Team, collect your laptop, set up MFA and meet your manager and buddy.

question: How long after joining can I still sign up for health insurance?
reference_answer: You must enrol in the people portal within 30 days of joining.

question: Who is the person assigned to help new starters settle in, and for how long?
reference_answer: A buddy from a different team supports you for your first 90 days, with weekly check-ins for the first six weeks.

question: How many months is the trial period for a new permanent hire?
reference_answer: Probation is 6 months and can be extended once by up to 3 months.

question: Can I take a long break using earned leave during my first three months?
reference_answer: Not normally. Earned leave accrues from your first month but can only be used after confirmation, apart from emergencies approved by your manager and the People Team.

question: How many casual days off do I get in a year?
reference_answer: 8 days per leave year, with at most 3 consecutive working days at a time.

question: After how many days of illness does the company require a doctor's note?
reference_answer: From the 3rd consecutive working day of sick leave.

question: How many unused vacation days can I roll over into next year?
reference_answer: Up to 30 days of earned leave can be carried forward; anything above that lapses on 31 March.

question: Where do I submit a time-off request and who signs it off?
reference_answer: In the people portal under Leave, then Apply. Your manager approves it within 2 working days.

question: I caught flu halfway through my vacation. Can those days be counted as sick leave instead?
reference_answer: Yes, if you tell your manager by 10:00 on the first sick day, are ill for 3 or more consecutive days and upload a medical certificate within 2 working days of returning.

question: How many weeks of maternity leave are given for a first baby?
reference_answer: 26 weeks on full pay, of which up to 8 weeks can be taken before the due date.

question: As a new father, how much time off can I take and by when must I use it?
reference_answer: 2 weeks on full pay, in one block or two, within 6 months of the child's birth. This is company policy.

question: I was asked to come in on a Sunday for a product release. Do I get time off in lieu?
reference_answer: Yes, if the work was approved: a full day earns 1 comp-off day. Record the credit in the people portal and use it within 45 days.

question: How many days a week am I allowed to work remotely?
reference_answer: Up to 2 days a week without special approval; Tuesday to Thursday are core office days.

question: I'd like to spend three weeks with family in Chennai while still working. What do I need to do?
reference_answer: Submit a Work location request in the people portal at least 5 working days ahead. You can work from another city in India for up to 20 working days a year.

question: Can I keep working while on a personal trip to Singapore?
reference_answer: Only with prior written approval from the People Team and Legal, requested at least 15 working days ahead, with a limit of 15 working days a year.

question: How do I get back the money I spent on a client trip?
reference_answer: Create a New claim at https://expenses.smartdesk.example with receipts for items over ₹500, within 30 days. Claims approved by the 20th are paid with that month's salary.

question: What's the most I can spend on a hotel night in Pune?
reference_answer: ₹5,000 per night excluding taxes, since Pune is outside the five cities with the ₹7,500 limit.

question: Will the company contribute to my broadband at home?
reference_answer: Yes, hybrid employees get ₹1,000 a month for home internet, claimed monthly with the bill.

question: Do employees have to confirm each year that they've read the behaviour rules?
reference_answer: Yes. When the code of conduct is updated you must acknowledge it in the people portal within 14 days of being asked.

question: A vendor wants to send me a festival hamper. Can I accept it?
reference_answer: Modest gifts are allowed, but anything above ₹3,000 must be reported within 5 working days. Cash can never be accepted.

question: What kinds of behaviour does the company treat as harassment?
reference_answer: Unwelcome sexual comments or contact, conduct based on characteristics such as gender, caste or religion, repeated humiliation or exclusion, and offensive material, in person or online.

question: A colleague keeps making inappropriate remarks to me. How do I raise this formally?
reference_answer: Email people@smartdesk.example or icc@smartdesk.example, call extension 4200, or use the confidential form under Raise a concern in the people portal. You get an acknowledgement within 2 working days.

question: By when do we agree on our objectives for the year?
reference_answer: Goals are agreed by 30 April, at the start of the 1 April to 31 March cycle.

question: What are the possible performance scores, and when are promotions decided?
reference_answer: A 5-point scale from Needs improvement to Outstanding. Promotions are considered from 1 April and 1 October.

question: I changed teams in August. Who writes my annual appraisal?
reference_answer: Your current manager writes it, after collecting written input from your previous manager on the time you worked together.

question: On which day does my salary reach my bank account?
reference_answer: On the last working day of the month, or the previous working day if that falls on a weekend or public holiday.

question: Where can I find last month's salary slip?
reference_answer: In the people portal under Pay, then Payslips. Download the PDF and open it with your employee ID in capital letters.

question: How do I tell payroll which income tax regime I have picked?
reference_answer: In the people portal open Pay, then Tax declaration, and choose your regime by 30 April. The new regime applies if you do not choose.

question: What share of my pay package is basic salary?
reference_answer: Basic pay is 40% of CTC.

question: When do my share options start to become mine?
reference_answer: Nothing vests in the first year. At the 1-year cliff 25% vests, then the rest vests monthly over the following 36 months.

question: If I quit, how long do I have to exercise the options I've already earned?
reference_answer: Vested options can be exercised within 90 days of your last working day. Unvested options lapse.

question: How many people work at SmartDesk AI and in which cities?
reference_answer: About 450 employees, with the head office in Bengaluru and a smaller office in Pune.
